definitions: The evaluation of a person's work or performance by a group of people in the same occupation, profession, or field.

A process by which a scholarly work (such as a paper or a research proposal) is evaluated by a group of experts in the same field to ensure it meets the necessary standards for publication or funding.
examples: The journal uses a rigorous peer review process.
Her article underwent extensive peer review.
He received positive feedback during his annual peer review.
